title: Amber Loop Policy Rules (v2)
description: The PDP rules surface (governance contract §6.2). schemaVersion 2 files may carry both v1 command-text rules (action/match/pattern) and v2 capability rules (decision + match{capability,target,effect,constraints}); schemaVersion 1 files keep working untouched. No forced v1→v2 migration; deny-wins across versions and families.

match.description: v1 text match when string-typed (exact|prefix|regex + pattern); v2 capability face when object-typed (§6.2).

decision.description: v2 decision face (§6.1 closed five-value set).
